metadata.title: Add Neovim project configuration for ALE integration
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Add `.nvim.lua` configuration file for Neovim/ALE users
- Configure colorcolumn to 200 (matching Black's line length)
- Set up ALE linters: mypy, ruff for Python; markdownlint for Markdown
- Enable automatic uv virtual environment detection
- Configure ALE fixers: ruff and black for Python files

## Benefits

- Improves out-of-the-box experience for Neovim users
- Aligns editor settings with project standards (200-char line length)
- Provides consistent linting configuration matching CI/CD pipeline
- Reduces manual configuration burden for contributors

## Test plan

- [x] File loaded correctly by Neovim
- [x] ALE integration working with configured linters
- [x] Colorcolumn displays at position 200 for Python files
- [x] No impact on non-Neovim users (editor-specific config)

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The comment incorrectly states 'Set colorcolumn to 100' but the code sets it to '200'. Update the comment to match the actual value being set.
```suggestion
-- Set colorcolumn to 200 for Python files only
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
[nitpick] Inconsistent spacing around the assignment operator. Use spaces around '=' for consistency with Lua conventions (e.g., `vim.g.ale_python_mypy_options = '--no-pretty'`).
```suggestion
vim.g.ale_python_ruff_options = '--extend-select I'
```

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull Request Overview This PR adds Neovim project configuration to integrate ALE (Asynchronous Lint Engine) with the project's existing linting and formatting tools.
